items.title: AI Answer Rank
items.description: Is your brand in the AI answer? A question types into a chat card, the assistant answers with a ranked list of three picks, then re-ranks: the promoted brand slides into its slot, the picks below step down, and the brand row lands with the one accent highlight and a check. For answer-engine and AI-visibility marketing

variables.label: Prompt
variables.description: The question typed into the user bubble. Up to about 60 characters keeps it on one or two lines.
variables.default: What's the best CRM for a small team?

variables.label: Answer lead-in
variables.description: The assistant line above the ranked list.

variables.label: Pick 1
variables.description: First pick in the original answer: a product other than the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: Pick 2
variables.description: Second pick in the original answer: a product other than the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: Pick 3
variables.description: Third pick in the original answer. It drops out of the top three when the brand lands.

variables.label: Brand
variables.description: The brand this video promotes, by its real name. It slides into the answer and takes the highlight.

variables.label: Brand rank
variables.description: The slot the brand lands in. Picks at and below it step down one place.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Highlight, monogram and check on the brand row, the one accent element.

variables.label: Ink
variables.description: Text colour; every placeholder surface is this ink at an alpha step.

variables.label: Ground
variables.description: Chat card surface; the page around it is the ground tinted toward the ink.

items.title: Aurora
items.description: Green and violet aurora curtains ripple across a night sky. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Blob
items.description: A soft coral and pink blob with a warm highlight slowly changes shape on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Chrome Orb
items.description: A mirror-chrome orb reflects a bright studio light, on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Cinemagraph
items.description: A still photograph with one living region: the frame is frozen while a single feathered window keeps moving - here, steam rising over a cup - drawn from the seek time alone with a period that divides the duration, so the render loops seamlessly. Swap the placeholder scene for a freeze-frame still masked over a looping video to cinemagraph real footage.

items.title: Color Wheel
items.description: A wide gradient slides slowly through the colours of the rainbow. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Exploded Stack
items.description: Isometric layer plates explode apart with a label beside each layer, hold, then collapse back into one stack. Built for architecture and system diagrams.

items.title: Extruded Logo
items.description: Beveled 3D letters flip up one by one, the word swings so light runs across the bevels, then settles for a readable hold. Chrome, gold or matte.

items.title: Falling Lines
items.description: White lines fall down the frame at varied speeds, each fading into a trail. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Flowing Gradient
items.description: Bands of orange and violet flow across the frame in a smooth gradient. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Fractal Noise
items.description: Soft grey fractal noise drifts across the frame like slow clouds. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Frost
items.description: A frozen blue orb with frost creeping in from its edge, on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Gabor Noise
items.description: Grey streaky noise drifts across the frame like a moving fingerprint. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Glass Hero
items.description: A solid glass object rises in front of a giant headline and keeps turning, so the type bends and splits into colour through it.

items.title: Godrays
items.description: Rays of light fan out from a corner and drift across a deep blue field. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Goo
items.description: A glossy green liquid ball whose surface bulges and ripples like wet goo, centred on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Gooey Split
items.description: A dot splits into a three-dot menu with a gooey metaball neck, spins into a swirl mark under directional shutter motion blur, then breaks back into three dots and merges into one. The goo is an SVG blur-and-threshold filter on the dots; the blur integrates each part along its real trajectory, so the smear follows the direction and speed of the spin.

items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Thermal colours flow through a glowing orb, on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Hologram
items.description: A pale blue holographic orb with scan rings and flicker, on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Holographic
items.description: An iridescent foil orb with a shifting rainbow sheen, centred on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Lens Flare
items.description: A camera lens flare: a bright star burst and a faint rainbow halo that slowly shimmer on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Light Edge
items.description: Purple and cyan light races around the edge of an orb on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Liquid Metal
items.description: A chrome sphere ripples and flows like molten metal on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Marble
items.description: Ink-dark veins wind through white in a marbled pattern that slowly shifts. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Mesh Gradient
items.description: Soft coral, orange and violet fields blend and drift in a mesh gradient. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Nebula
items.description: A small world of pink and blue gas swirls inside a sphere on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Obsidian
items.description: A dark glass orb catches pink and cyan iridescent light on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Plasma
items.description: Deep violet plasma folds and churns across the whole frame. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Plastic
items.description: A glossy white plastic orb with soft studio reflections, on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Prism
items.description: A white beam of light splits into a slowly turning rainbow. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Product Turntable
items.description: A product turns a full revolution on a studio plinth in a seamless loop. Drop in a GLB or glTF model, or keep the built-in drink can with your own label.

items.title: Ripples
items.description: Concentric rings ripple outward from the centre, white on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Sine Wave
items.description: A glowing white sine wave travels across a black frame. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Snow
items.description: Seek-safe falling-snow overlay: sparse or dense flakes drift down with size, speed and opacity correlated per flake for depth, radial-masked so the frame center stays clear

variables.label: Density
variables.description: Flake count across the frame.

variables.label: Fall speed
variables.description: How fast flakes fall and sway.

items.title: Spiral
items.description: A bold black and white spiral turns in the frame. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Starfield
items.description: Seek-safe night-sky overlay: sparse or dense stars in three size tiers that twinkle and drift in two parallax layers, radial-masked to keep the frame center clear

variables.label: Density
variables.description: Star count across the frame.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Star color mix.

variables.label: Twinkle speed
variables.description: How fast stars pulse.

items.title: Strands
items.description: Thin ribbons of pink and blue light weave across a black field. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Stripes
items.description: Bold black and white diagonal stripes slide across the frame. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Sun Burst
items.description: Cream and black rays fan out from the centre and slowly turn. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Swirl
items.description: Orange and blue color fields swirl and flow into each other across the whole frame. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Thin Film
items.description: An orb's rim shimmers with soap-bubble iridescence on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Voronoi
items.description: Magenta cells with glowing blue centres shift and reshape across the frame. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Water
items.description: A sphere of wind-rippled water reflecting a blue sky, on black. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Waveform
items.description: Equalizer bars in a blue to pink gradient pulse across the middle of the frame, like an audio visualizer. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Week in Merges
items.description: Each author's avatar bounces across their row at a speed set by how many pull requests they merged

parameters.label: Footer
parameters.default: Speed proportional to merges · By PR author

parameters.label: Rows (JSON array of name, merges, avatar)

variables.label: Footer
variables.default: Speed proportional to merges · By PR author

variables.label: Rows (JSON array of name, merges, avatar)
Maximum rows
variables.description: Authors drawn, highest merge count first.

variables.label: Overflow line
variables.description: Line for everyone past the cap. Empty writes it from the rows left out.

items.title: Worley Noise
items.description: A field of drifting cells, light at their centres and dark at their edges. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT).

items.title: Agent Cursor
items.description: An AI agent operating a UI: a cursor with an accent name label that types out each step, clicks each target with a small ring, and ends on a check.

variables.label: Status steps
variables.description: Comma-separated: a reading line, one line per target, then a done line.
variables.default: Reading the page,Opening Settings,Turning on backups,Done

variables.label: Click targets
variables.description: Semicolon-separated x,y points in percent of the frame.

items.title: Caret Swap
items.description: A gradient caret expands over one phrase, collapses to the left, then types its replacement with a blinking caret.

variables.label: From text
variables.description: The phrase covered by the expanding caret.

variables.label: To text
variables.description: The replacement phrase, typed one character at a time.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum size in pixels. Both phrases shrink together to fit the host.

variables.label: Font weight
variables.description: Weight used by both phrases. Every option is included in the bundled Geist font.

variables.label: Text color
variables.description: Color of both phrases.

variables.label: Caret top
variables.description: Top color of the caret gradient.

variables.label: Caret bottom
variables.description: Bottom color of the caret gradient.

items.title: Annotate Cursor
items.description: A marker pen glides onto the frame and hand-draws a loose loop, an underline, or an arrow around a region, the ink laid exactly under its nib, then lifts and leaves.

items.title: Context Menu Cursor
items.description: A cursor right-clicks a file, a context menu blooms from its tip, the hover highlight tracks the item under it, and the chosen action plays out: duplicate, rename, move to trash, or a confirmation toast.

items.title: Drag and Drop Cursor
items.description: A cursor grabs a task card, lifts and tilts it into its motion, carries it in lockstep to an empty column, drops it with a small settle, and the list closes the gap behind it.

items.title: Marquee Select Cursor
items.description: A cursor drags a selection rectangle across a photo grid; each tile rings and pops a check the frame the rectangle touches it, while a pill counts the selection up.

items.title: Text Select Cursor
items.description: An arrow turns into an I-beam over a document, drags a selection across a phrase character by character, raises a format toolbar, turns back into an arrow and clicks Bold.

variables.label: Paragraph
variables.default: Our spring release ships on Thursday. Teams can now share a live review link, collect time-stamped comments, and approve the final cut without leaving the editor. Early customers cut their review rounds in half.

items.title: Zoom Follow Cursor
items.description: Screen-recording auto-zoom: the camera pushes in toward each upcoming click, trails the cursor on a smooth spring, marks every click with a press and a ring, then eases back out to the full screen as the cursor leaves.

variables.label: Screenshot
variables.description: Your own screen capture. Leave empty for the built-in dashboard.

items.title: Curtain Reveal
items.description: Two pleated stage curtains gather outward from center, the way real velvet bunches at the tieback, revealing the stage underneath. A static pelmet frames the top; a soft spotlight can bloom in as they part.

variables.label: Curtain tone
variables.description: Curtain color.

variables.label: Pelmet
variables.description: Static valance framing the top of the stage.

variables.label: Spotlight
variables.description: Soft glow blooming over the stage as the curtains part.

items.title: Dart Cursor
items.description: A bold outlined arrowhead that dives in from camera depth, flies nose-first with motion blur along its path, squashes on two clicks, and whips out of frame.

items.title: Magnetic Cursor
items.description: A soft dot pointer glides across an editor toolbar, is pulled into each button and morphs into its rounded hover plate while the icon leans toward it, presses one, and leaves as a dot.

variables.label: Buttons visited
variables.description: Comma-separated indexes 0-5: bold, italic, underline, link, list, image.

items.title: Paper Collage Reveal
items.description: A scrapbook patchwork of torn paper scraps, each with its own texture and tilt, flutters away in a staggered scatter to reveal the content underneath.

variables.label: Panels
variables.description: How many torn paper scraps cover the frame.

variables.label: Paper tone
variables.description: Color per scrap. Mixed seeds a different tone per scrap for a real scrapbook mix.

variables.label: Spread
variables.description: Outward sends each scrap away from the frame center. Scatter sends every scrap the same general direction with seeded variance.

items.title: Pendulum Swing
items.description: Content hangs from a fixed pivot and swings into rest with gravity-damped oscillation, like a hanging sign settling on its hook.

variables.label: Pivot
variables.description: Where the content hangs from. The swing rotates about this point, so the top edge stays pinned.

variables.label: Amplitude
variables.description: How far the first swing reaches before it settles. Every later swing scales with it, so the pendulum still comes to rest upright.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Which side the pendulum swings in from: right lifts the first swing clockwise, left mirrors it.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Content colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

items.title: Torn Paper Rip
items.description: A fibrous paper tear runs across the frame: the torn sheet shows its white paper core along the edge and lifts away on a soft shadow, leaving the next scene standing.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Which way the tear travels across the frame.

variables.label: Paper tone
variables.description: Color of the exposed paper cross-section riding the tear.

variables.label: Roughness
variables.description: How jagged and fibrous the tear edge is. Low is a clean deckle edge, high is roughly torn.
